title: Heat, sunlight and water
subtitle: What the vine needs to ripen
objectives: Explain the role of heat and sunlight
Explain how water stress affects quality
Name the natural influences that cool or warm a site

steps.title: Heat and sunlight
steps.body: The vine needs warmth to grow and to ripen sugar, tannin and aroma. Sunlight drives photosynthesis, the process that makes sugar in the leaves. Too little heat and grapes stay sour and green. Too much and sugar races ahead of flavour, while acidity drops. Balance is what growers look for.

steps.title: Water: not too much, not too little
steps.body: A vine needs about 500 to 700 mm of water a year. Too much and it grows leaves instead of fruit, with large, diluted berries. Mild water stress after veraison is good: berries stay small and the vine focuses on ripening. Severe drought shuts the vine down. In dry regions, drip irrigation lets growers control the dose.
steps.highlight: Mild stress concentrates; drought stops ripening

steps.prompt: A small amount of water stress after veraison can improve grape quality.
steps.explanation: Yes. Mild stress keeps berries small and pushes the vine to ripen fruit instead of growing more leaves.

steps.title: Natural influences
steps.body: Large bodies of water moderate temperatures, keeping winters milder and summers cooler, like the Atlantic in Bordeaux. Cold ocean currents cool coastal regions, like the Humboldt current in Chile. Altitude cools a site by roughly 0.6 degrees per 100 m, which is why Mendoza's vineyards at 1,000 m keep their freshness. Fog does the same in Napa and Sonoma.
steps.highlight: Water, currents, altitude and fog cool a site

steps.prompt: Why does Mendoza make fresh wines despite its warm, sunny latitude?
options: Its vineyards sit at high altitude
It is close to the equator
steps.explanation: Altitude cools the air, about 0.6 degrees per 100 m, so cool nights preserve acidity even in strong sun.

steps.title: What you learned
points: Heat ripens grapes and sunlight makes sugar
Mild water stress after veraison improves quality
Water, ocean currents, altitude and fog cool a site
